records.run: central green+red galaxies, z<0.075, least-squares fit

axes.yDefinition: log10 average stellar surface mass density within a circular aperture of radius 1 kpc, Sigma_1

scatter.meaning: 1 sigma scatter of green and red galaxies about the relation

selection.warning: SDSS DR7 central galaxies (most massive group member, Yang+12), 0.005<z<0.075, b/a>0.6, green-valley and red-sequence (NUV-r>4) galaxies only, 9.75<log M*<11.25, volume-limited per 0.25 dex mass bin; blue-cloud galaxies lie below the ridge and are excluded from the fit. Not a relation for all galaxies. zRepresentative is the midpoint of 0.005<z<0.075 (not a median). The drawn line in Fig. 4 spans log M* 9-11.5; the fit uses the 9.75-11.25 sample. IMF and cosmology are not stated in the paper. Sigma_1 is from SDSS i-band surface-brightness profiles converted with a g-i colour M/L calibrated on the MPA/JHU masses, so it inherits SDSS seeing (HWHM 0.7 arcsec ~ 1 kpc at z=0.075).

definitions.sigma1Definition: average surface mass density within a circular aperture of radius 1 kpc, computed by directly integrating the mass profiles from the innermost point out to R=1 kpc

provenance.citation: Fang et al. 2013, ApJ 776, 63 (arXiv:1308.5224), fit to Fig. 4 (Sigma_1 vs M*)

records.notes: Fit 9.29(+0.10,-0.10) + 0.64(+0.23,-0.20)(log M* - 10.25), 1 sigma scatter 0.16 dex (bootstrap 16-84%). Drawn line in f4.pdf reproduces the closed form to 0.006 dex at all vertices.

records.run: central green+red galaxies, sigma scaled to 1 kpc, z<0.075, least-squares fit

axes.yDefinition: log10 SDSS fibre velocity dispersion scaled to a circular aperture of radius 1 kpc, sigma_1

scatter.meaning: 1 sigma vertical scatter of green and red galaxies about the relation

selection.warning: SDSS DR7 central galaxies (most massive group member, Yang+12), 0.005<z<0.075, b/a>0.6, green-valley and red-sequence (NUV-r>4) galaxies only, 9.75<log M*<11.25, volume-limited per 0.25 dex mass bin; blue-cloud galaxies lie below the ridge and are excluded from the fit. Not a relation for all galaxies. The aperture is 1 kpc (not R_e and not the 3 kpc of Zahid+16): fibre dispersions were scaled with sigma ~ R^-0.66 (Cappellari+06). zRepresentative is the midpoint of the redshift range. IMF and cosmology not stated.

definitions.sigmaDefinition: SDSS fibre (3 arcsec) stellar velocity dispersion scaled to a circular aperture of radius 1 kpc with sigma ~ R^-0.66 (Cappellari+06); 1D line of sight
definitions.sigmaDimension: 1D line of sight, scaled to 1 kpc aperture

provenance.citation: Fang et al. 2013, ApJ 776, 63 (arXiv:1308.5224), fit to Fig. 11 (sigma_1 vs M*)

records.notes: Fit 2.09(+0.05,-0.08) + 0.29(+0.13,-0.10)(log M* - 10.25); 1 sigma scatter 0.09 dex. Drawn line in f11.pdf reproduces the closed form to 0.004 dex at all vertices.
